newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NSW Australia grain receivals set new record.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NSW Australia grain receivals set new record.

text.p: A record of more than a million tonnes of grain was delivered last week at storage facilities of co-operative GrainCorp in the leading Australian grain-producing state of New South Wales (NSW), the group said on Tuesday.
The record may be swifly toppled as one of the state's greatest-ever harvests hits top gear, it said in a statement.
Harvesting began in northern NSW just over three weeks ago and so far more than two million tonnes of grain had been received, it said.
With only half of GrainCorp's 202 sites presently open, the potential to exceed the new record was very strong, it said.
Walgett, the largest receival site in NSW received more than 17,000 tonnes of grain in a single day, while another 15 sites had been receiving more than 5,000 tonnes of grain each day, it said.

GrainCorp Narrabri regional manager John Armstrong said despite inevitable frustrations given the size of the harvest, the region's objective was to get more than two million tonnes into storage by the end of November.
Upgraded GrainCorp sites are operating on extended hours with extra staff to receive the near-record crop.

Despite early concern that a significant proportion of the crop may have suffered from too much or too little rain, grain being received at silos was generally high quality, GrainCorp managing director Tom Keene said.
In Narrabri 60 percent of wheat receivals were evenly divided between premium grades of Prime Hard, Australian Hard-1 and Australian Premium White, he said.
The harvest had yet to fully get underway in the south of NSW, he said.
The harvest of winter grain mainly comprises wheat with some barley.
